name: Kunimi Nana
source:
A quiet and kind girl. She's attached to Takafumi, her older brother. Because she doesn't want to worry her family, she keeps her sexual activities a secret. The ribbon she uses to tie her hair is a gift from Takafumi, which is her favorite hair accessory. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.appetite-game.com/apt_020/apt_020_chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
